title: Dispatch: classification-complete absence and full-path projection nodes (attempt 9)
description:
Fresh full review of PR #477 at 7d86c64: one P1. NO new defect class — it remains
the existing source-negative semantic-proof invariant — so a FIX-VERIFICATION
review is permitted next PROVIDED THE CONTRACT STAYS UNCHANGED. Add no new
invariant classes; if you think the contract must change, report it instead.

CLOSED BY THE PREVIOUS ROUND — do not touch: cross-record scanning now works, the
split-sibling regression proves detection on another record, and the committed
pack now produces blockers for all 12 source-negative rows.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/bootstrap-capability-ledger.json
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/bootstrap-capability-ledger.md
  packages/core/src/rules/bootstrapCapabilityLedger.ts
  packages/core/test/bootstrapCapabilityLedger.test.ts

=== P1-A: projectionNodes EMITS ONLY OBJECTS ===
Supervisor-confirmed at bootstrapCapabilityLedger.ts:1539-1555:
  * arrays recurse per item, but a primitive item hits objectRecord() -> null ->
    return, so primitive array elements produce NO node;
  * scalars produce no node for the same reason;
  * the root 'data' object is deliberately skipped by
    "if (currentPath !== 'data')".
So paths the predicates explicitly list are invisible:
    data.halfDamage   = true                        -> no node
    data.saveAbilities = ['strength','dexterity']    -> no node
FIX: emit a node for every path — scalars, primitive array elements, and the
root data object included — carrying the path and its value so predicates can
see both.

=== P1-B: THE 'CLOSED ALLOWED SCHEMA' CLAIM IS UNSUPPORTED — THE DEEPER HALF ===
RulesRecord.data is typed 'unknown', and the baseline kind validator requires
only an object with an optional description. It does NOT reject unregistered
fields. There is therefore NO closed representation schema to enumerate against.

Consequence: a schema-valid field such as alternateSaveAbilities,
higherSlotScaling or trainingLedger can carry the missing semantic projection
while matching no hand-written applicability key, and the resolver returns
SATISFIED — concluding absence from its own failure to recognise the material.

DO NOT FIX THIS BY ADDING MORE KEYS. That is the same defect one iteration later,
and this program has already spent rounds on alias lists that were always one
unregistered field short.

REQUIRED — CLASSIFICATION-COMPLETE ABSENCE. For each record examined, every
structured path must land in exactly one of:
  (a) MATCHES the projection shape        -> the obligation is NOT absent;
  (b) REGISTERED IRRELEVANT to this shape -> ignore, by explicit registration;
  (c) UNCLASSIFIED                        -> the row resolves evidence-underived.
Absence may be concluded ONLY when zero unclassified structured material remains.
Recognising nothing is not evidence of absence — that equivalence is the defect.

=== GENERATED REGRESSION MATRIX ===
Produce permanent evidence for EVERY ProjectionShape crossed with:
  scalar field | primitive array | split sibling | cross-record structure |
  schema-valid unregistered key
Generate it from the shape list rather than hand-writing cases, so a newly added
shape cannot ship without coverage. The unregistered-key case must assert
evidence-underived, NOT satisfied.

=== EXPECT THE BLOCKER SET TO GROW, POSSIBLY TO ALL 12 AND BEYOND ===
Once unclassified material forces evidence-underived, many rows that currently
resolve will stop resolving. That is the correct and honest outcome; the
fail-closed closure gate already handles it and the PR body already states that
the gate reports not-ready. Do NOT register keys wholesale as irrelevant, widen
predicates, or otherwise tune the result to keep a smaller blocker count.
Registering a field as irrelevant is a claim that it CANNOT carry the shape —
make it only where that is true.

=== ENVIRONMENT / CONSTRAINTS ===
npm ci first; npm run verify:worktree BEFORE committing. Edit only the four files
above. A sibling dispatch runs on PR #475. Do not touch package.json,
internal.ts, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .github/, or any script/CI file. Do not
regenerate the pack or run the importer. Do not modify any bead but your own; no
bd dolt push; no push, PR comment, or merge. The PR body is the supervisor's to
fix, after the push.
acceptance_criteria:
• projectionNodes emits a node for every path including scalars, primitive array elements, and the root data object.
• Absence is classification-complete: every structured path matches, is registered irrelevant, or forces evidence-underived; absence is concluded only with zero unclassified material.
• No fix relies on adding applicability keys to cover the reported examples.
• A generated matrix covers every ProjectionShape across scalar, primitive-array, split-sibling, cross-record and schema-valid unregistered-key cases, driven from the shape list so a new shape cannot ship uncovered.
• The unregistered-key case asserts evidence-underived rather than satisfied.
• The blocker set is allowed to grow; nothing is registered irrelevant or widened to keep it small.
• Contract unchanged, so fix-verification review remains permissible.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
